title: Kernel-check the HPE component-bound packed comparator
body:
PR2499 kernel-checks the Gaussian-integer energy law needed by PR1859's smaller packed radix, but leaves the final comparator implication open. This package completes that standalone theorem in the same unchanged energy grammar: for C counts k1,k2<=K and B=2^(K+2), equality of the two appropriately scaled Gaussian packed row sums implies equality of every corresponding scaled entry.

The proof combines the imported squared-energy bound, signed component bounds, unequal-count scaling, strict signed-digit uniqueness, both Gaussian components and finite packed-row linearity. Ten new theorem roots compile in Lean4.34.1; actual transitive axiom reports contain only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Four false Lean statements fail: relaxing the strict digit bound, ignoring the imaginary component, omitting relative C scaling and dropping a final column.

PR1906 and PR1934 already supply and independently audit the sharper written K+1-bit threshold using whole-row energy. They are credited; their Gaussian energy-ball theorem remains outside this formalization. This proves the K+2-bit component-bound contract from the available column-energy grammar, not a new or sharpest radix bound.

The source-bound observer executes the unchanged PR1859 comparator and its12 existing controls. It captures all3,072 basis-column outputs from the six literal circuits, reconstructs the packed row sums and checks6,144 real/imaginary packed components. All three actual pairs retain k1=9,k2=7,K=9, scales1/4 and B=2048. The known5,622-versus10,221-bit packed inputs remain predecessor results; no timing improvement is claimed.

Validation: full registered CPython3.12.7 replay, optimized Git-free replay, three actual source/formal corruption rejections and typed bool/int receipt control. Fresh Lean compilation imports the vendored Energy module from source, with no reused olean. A separate AI reviewer read the proof and external binding, freshly compiled both Lean modules, and independently passed the optimized Python replay. Exact pins and the formal/Python boundary are in SOURCES.json, VENDOR.json, FORMAL.json and BOUNDARY.md.

The theorem's ColumnEntry witnesses may come from different runs/dimensions; only their energy bound is needed. A common source matrix, literal parsing and gate-execution correspondence remain external finite evidence. The Python observer uses the predecessor compiler/executor and is not a new independent gate engine. No formal bridge to the retained Lean4.21/Mathlib gz/runZ, selected-checker replacement, supplier, physical hosting, precision/tape theorem or new kappa is claimed. The remaining next step is that formal interpreter translation, not more finite examples.

Credit ywz65/PR2499 for the retained energy grammar, woklerx/PR1859 for the written bound and executor, Jeremy Kothe/PR593 for the Clifford formalization and original packed argument, commdata2338 for the parser, and the inherited Lemma A/G lineage. New composition and controls by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Separate AI review is not independent human review or maintainer acceptance. Generic package CI does not run Lean; no hosted CI result is claimed.

Final overlap recovered complete pagination of768 open PRs at15:00:19UTC and1,232 Discussion records at15:03:35UTC with no warnings, plus1,538 local notes. Discussion1896 and PR1906/1934's sharper written scope were inspected. Canonical main and PR2499 remain at their pinned heads. This coverage is not a novelty guarantee.
